title: Canonical ordinary-etale locally closed exceptional scalar maps
statement: Use ordinary unbounded small-etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. For finite commutative rings $A,B$, a map $\phi:A\to B$ and a scheme $T$, write $F_T=-\otimes_A^LB$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. For a closed immersion $g:Z\hookrightarrow X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion], define $Rg_R^!$ to be the right adjoint of $Rg_{*,R}$ supplied by the ordinary closed ambient adjunction [lem-exc-closed-ambient], and use that fixed adjunction. For an open immersion $j:S\hookrightarrow Z$ [def-weil-open-immersion] paste it with $j_!\dashv j^*$ to obtain $Rg_*j_!\dashv j^*Rg^!$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support]. Let $c_{g,N}:F_XRg_{*,A}N\to Rg_{*,B}F_ZN$ be the ordinary-counit comparison [lem-coef-finite-direct-image]. Define its totalized inverse to be $c_{g,N}^{-1}$ when $c_{g,N}$ is invertible and zero otherwise. Define $b_{g,M}:F_ZRg_A^!M\to Rg_B^!F_XM$ as the exceptional-adjunction transpose of this inverse at $N=Rg_A^!M$ followed by $F_X\epsilon_{g,A}$. Define $b_{s,M}:F_Sj^*Rg_A^!M\to j^*Rg_B^!F_XM$ as the canonical scalar/restriction identification followed by $j^*b_{g,M}$ [lem-coef-etale-open-tensor]. Define $q_{s,P}=c_{g,j_!P};Rg_*(q_{j,P})$, with the canonical open scalar isomorphism. For a predicate $C_T$ on $D(T,A)$, define the comparison predicate to be the conjunction of: $c_{g,N}$ invertible for $C_Z(N)$; for $C_X(M)$, $C_Z(Rg_A^!M)$ and $C_S(j^*Rg_A^!M)$ and invertibility of $c_{g,Rg_A^!M}$, $b_{g,M}$ and $b_{s,M}$, with $q_{s,s_A^!M};s_{!,B}(b_{s,M});\epsilon_{s,B}=F_X\epsilon_{s,A}$; invertibility of $q_{s,P}$ for $C_S(P)$; naturality of $b_g,b_s,q_s$ in all morphisms between the corresponding $C$ objects; and equality of the composite exceptional counit with $Rg_*$ of the open counit followed by the closed counit. At positive quotient coefficient levels [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension] the prescribed domain predicate is $D^b_{ctf}$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. This defines the maps and the predicate only, without asserting the predicate or assuming these maps invertible outside its stated locus.

def etaleShriekLocallyClosedCoefficientMap
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {S Z X : Scheme.{u}} (g : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion g]
    (j : S ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j] (M : DerivedCategoryModule A X) :
    (scalarExtension φ S).obj
        ((derivedRestriction (A := A) j).obj ((etaleShriekClosedExceptional A g).obj M)) ⟶
      (derivedRestriction (A := B) j).obj
        ((etaleShriekClosedExceptional B g).obj ((scalarExtension φ X).obj M))
